label: Proposed/Recommended475; synthetic contracts, no implementation or execution
authority: Proposed normative design; final schemas implemented later and validated independently

ConnectorSource.source_set: immutable raw bytes hashes, official URL/license/date/dialect, recursively captured reference map; build-time only
ConnectorSource.operations: All source operations preserved including blocked/unsupported; no implemented/live flags copied from old repo

TypedOperation.inputs: Location+wire-name+stable field ID+JSON pointer+type+presence/nullable/default+style/explode/allowReserved+sensitivity; required list is per request variant
TypedOperation.responses: Every declared status/media/schema variant, body/record/binary semantics and returned relationship identity; no preferred-only collapse

Value.precision: Integer/decimal wire values use canonical exact strings with precision/scale metadata where JSON number cannot remain lossless across Go/browser; no float64 coercion
Value.temporal: Instant includes zone/offset normalization; timestamp without zone preserves wall-time semantics, never guessed UTC

RunSpec.execution_grant: Persisted independent expiry/revocation epochs, not short-lived login-session token
RunSpec.schedule_origin: Adopt existing effect-free workflow only after occurrence admission; binding-outbox, no duplicate StartRun

DispatchIntent.effect_identity: Stable intended action occurrence; entity identity alone insufficient
DispatchIntent.send_rule: Persist exact intent and reserve outcome/readback capacity before one physical send; ambiguous retry uses same proven provider idempotency contract or reconciliation

MemberOutcome.correlation: Provider documented key/order with exact cardinality only; unknown missing/extra/unmapped results retained; never aggregate input count as success

Checkpoint.continuation: Tagged kind/presence/opaque bytes, tie-breaker and unread-tail reference as applicable; exact complete identity participates in CAS
Checkpoint.commit: Only exact acknowledged prefix and verified published object manifest advance together in PG

ArtifactRef.publication: Unique immutable object; SHA256 not ETag; complete+verify before PG manifest. No arbitrary URL/path membership
ArtifactRef.gc: Reservations, runs, manifests, accepted plans, proof receipts and backup retention checked before deletion

Scenario.steps: Ordered dependency DAG: setup invokes real commands, captures actual returned IDs, write/readback/cleanup uses those; shared fixtures explicit and bounded
Scenario.assertions: Independent expected fields, effects, byte hashes, stored rows and cursor transitions, never copied from actual response as oracle
Scenario.cleanup: Owned created IDs only, retained even after failure; does not invalidate independent passes

Proof.sanitization: Sensitive values excluded or hashes/references under scoped access; no token/header/body leakage; actual sanitized request/response and expected-vs-observed assertions retained
Proof.reuse: Original physical run timestamp/binary/source preserved; new invocation may reuse only current exact independent pass, never present cached as freshly executed

FoundationGap.dedupe: Same missing semantic contract deduplicated independent of provider name; compatible handler extension preferred, otherwise versioned foundation. Bounded SQL/native adapter only for actual non-HTTP transport
FoundationGap.authority: Authoring impact view only; never runtime proof gate or HTTP escape hatch

ScheduleRevision.calendar_semantics: Temporal DOM AND DOW; missing wall time skipped, both repeated UTC instants trigger
ScheduleRevision.update: PG If-Match/outbox, low-level Temporal Describe conflict token; persistent RequestId per exact mutation dispatch; new rebase gets new linked ID

Configuration.pg: pm_app only for PM pool; separate temporal, temporal_visibility, pm_objects_meta databases/roles; customer Postgres connector explicitly distinct
Configuration.temporal: private authenticated namespace per deployment; workload task queues, explicit retention/versioning/fairness
Configuration.objects: One qualified S3 contract; bundled Seaweed or managed provisioned backend
Configuration.secrets: Operator KMS/key mount references and PG ciphertext; no plaintext defaults
Configuration.limits: Explicit per-tenant run slots, account requests/cooldowns, bytes, rows, memory, scratch, history, upload, event buffer and backlog caps

ServerEvent.sequence: Per-run integer allocated while locking that run row in the same PG state/event transaction. No global bigserial commit-order assumption.
ServerEvent.sse_id: Opaque signed scope/run/sequence cursor; clients dedupe sequence and resnapshot only on explicit retention gap.
ServerEvent.payload: Safe refs/counts/reason codes only; never raw provider data/secrets.

Task.state: Known task scheduling state separate from member outcomes and cancel intent; unknown effects remain visible.
Task.ownership: PG application state; Temporal activity attempt is execution observation, never task identity.

CredentialBinding.public_projection: Only opaque reference/version/status when authorized; no value, private locator or raw scope token.
CredentialBinding.resolution: Worker receives signer after run/reconciliation grant check. API admin can encrypt ingress; public clients never resolve.

PhysicalHTTPAttempt.initial_transport_policy: Provider HTTP transport uses HTTP/1.1 with DisableKeepAlives=true, ForceAttemptHTTP2=false and a non-nil empty TLSNextProto map; redirects are disabled and separately admitted. No synthesized Idempotency-Key or replayable GetBody for unsafe writes.
PhysicalHTTPAttempt.tradeoff: Fresh connections cost latency/TLS work. Qualification tests verify one physical provider request per durable attempt. HTTP2-only providers remain unsupported until a separately proven single-attempt transport exists. API ingress/browser transports are unaffected.
PhysicalHTTPAttempt.retry_owner: Temporal retries safe logical activities after durable disposition; transport never hides repeated provider sends.
PhysicalHTTPAttempt.source: Pinned Go1.27.1 net/http/transport.go89–97 and retry eligibility behavior inspected in473. V28/V74 must fault connection reuse/response loss before enabling pooling or HTTP2.

identities.invariant: Opaque stable ID; workspace belongs to exactly one org
One human may hold multiple workspace memberships; identity provider subject is issuer-scoped
Versioned policy epoch, expiry/revocation; role alone not permission to every connection
Org-owned, explicit workspace/connection/operation scopes, expiry and separate credential rotation
At most one explicit delegation hop initially; cannot exceed parent grant; immutable requested_actor/effective_actor attribution
Mandatory in every workspace route and CLI effect invocation; no mutable global current workspace
Aliases may share provider account but grants remain separate
Shared distributed auth/rate coordination identity; safe nonreversible internal key, never raw credential

identities.purpose: Opaque reference to server-owned ciphertext version
identities.invariant: No raw value/locator in CLI/UI public schema/history
Immutable revisions; stable creation ledger survives nonidentity revisions
Exact schema/account/mapping/actions/budgets; If-Match for editable candidates, immutable accepted snapshot
Revisioned graph; no inferred dependencies
Stable across Temporal retries and ContinueAsNew; source of public run identity

API-origin uses pm/run/<opaque UUID>; schedule-origin adopts its actual Temporal execution after effect-free admission. Both map to stable PM run identity; never start a second workflow for admitted schedule origin.
Changes across retries/ContinueAsNew; mapped as orchestration observations
Source/destination account/resource/key + explicit creation generation
Entity key + explicit logical action occurrence/revision where semantically required; exact retry retains key
Ordered member IDs, payload hash/ref, attempt and pre-I/O intent
Never infer result from aggregate counts or response array position without declared contract
Workspace scope, digest/length/media/object version; no arbitrary paths or client storage authority

session_and_run_grant_policy: Session validity is checked at API acceptance and control actions only. Accepted jobs use durable execution grants with their own expiry, membership/service/delegation/connection/approval policy epochs and explicit revocation. Ordinary logout or login-session expiry does not cancel accepted work. Explicit principal/run-grant revocation stops future dispatch; already sent effects remain observable under restricted reconciliation-only read authority, which cannot create new mutations.

synthetic_server_config.label: SYNTHETIC proposed config; addresses/references not real credentials or endpoints

aggregate_rule: Unknown effects prevent clean failure/cancel/success claim. Orchestration closure is observation only; complete exact effect/member/checkpoint evidence owns terminal business outcome.
all_examples: Synthetic proposal, not command availability or actual receipt.
